author: Netuxx
body:
Normaly people who spend all the time playing Walls or Minotaur(Avicade) knows where the Op stuff is or where to go to dodge the wrong ways. I know this can bee hard to make but it can be really useful for who dont know the maps and dont want to lose easly.
This idea can be implemented...

On walls:
Randomize Ores, on YML you can put a region and the probably on what every Block can be placed by the plugin after the Match starts.

On Minotaur:
Randomize passages, make a region of the differents passage options and a region where the original passages are. The original Passages will be copied randomly on the different passage options.

Thats all, thanks for reading and sorry for my bad english.
Cya later!
~Netox
